quality.review_scope: Complete author text and visual reading of main pp.1–10 and SI pp.1–6. All source-described preparation, characterization, device and cost branches are retained; cited external full recipes and unprinted plot values are not imported.
missing_fields: All ten main and six SI pages were read as text and faithful page images. Cited external full methods remain outside this local source review.
Missing reaction charges, physical batch joins, plot coordinates and measurement conditions are not reconstructed.
Source-linked data and figures do not establish measured atomic coordinates or task-specific training eligibility.
No one selected growth temperature or duration is assigned to this representative family record.
The separate stock components do not establish dissolved lead speciation.
conflicts: Main p.3 Section 2.2 reports PbO as 232 mg and 1 mmol. Both printed values are retained; no stoichiometric correction is substituted.
Main p.2 Figure 1a labels argon and 40–100 °C; the main p.3 procedure states nitrogen and 40–120 °C. These source statements remain unresolved.
